# Cactus Property Solutions

> Local cash home buyer serving Phoenix, Tucson, and all of Arizona.
> We buy single-family homes, condos, townhomes, and small multifamily
> for cash, close in 7-30 days, and pay all closing costs. No agent
> commissions, no repair credits, no contingencies. Locally operated,
> funded with our own capital — not a national iBuyer.

## Service area

All of Arizona — Maricopa, Pima, Pinal, Yavapai, Coconino, Yuma,
Mohave, Cochise counties. Primary cities:

- Phoenix (85001-85099)
- Tucson (85701-85775)
- Mesa (85201-85215)
- Scottsdale (85250-85268)
- Chandler (85224-85249)
- Gilbert (85233-85298)
- Glendale (85301-85311)
- Tempe (85281-85289)
- Plus Peoria, Surprise, Goodyear, Buckeye, Avondale, Queen Creek,
  Apache Junction, Casa Grande, Flagstaff, Prescott, Sedona, Yuma,
  Lake Havasu City, Sierra Vista, Kingman

## Offer terms

- Free, no-obligation written cash offer within 24 hours
- Close in as fast as 7 days, typical close 14-30 days
- Properties bought as-is — no repair credits, no inspection
  re-negotiations
- Cactus Property Solutions pays all closing costs
- We use our own capital — no financing or appraisal contingencies
- Closing at a Maricopa, Pima, or other AZ county title company

## Seller situations we work with

- Pre-foreclosure (AZ is a non-judicial state — Trustee's Sale
  process under ARS Title 33, Chapter 6.1; 90-120 day timeline;
  we close before auction)
- Inherited / probate houses (AZ probate under ARS Title 14;
  informal probate typically 4-8 months; Maricopa County and
  Pima County Superior Court most common venues)
- Divorce sales (AZ is community property; both parties cash out
  same date)
- Distressed / as-is properties (fire, monsoon damage, foundation
  cracks from caliche soil, pool neglect, hoarding, long-vacant
  snowbird homes)
- Snowbird and second-home exits (very common in Maricopa County)
- Out-of-state inheritances (entire transaction handled remotely
  via overnight mail or remote online notarization)
- Job relocations (Intel, Honeywell, Banner Health, Mayo Clinic,
  Wells Fargo, U of A)
- Tired landlords and investor exits

## When a cash sale is not the right choice

If the property is in good condition, the seller has time for a
60-90 day MLS listing, and there are no urgency factors (Trustee's
Sale, divorce timeline, condition issues) — a traditional listing
with a local agent will typically net the seller more after costs.
We'll say so on the first call when that's the right answer.

## What we are not

We are not realtors. We do not list properties on the MLS. We are
a professional home-buying operation purchasing with our own funds.
